description: Will a Duffer fit a room? Give the room's width, depth and ceiling height in whole inches. Returns the verdict the duffergolf.net fit checker shows (fits, tight, ask or no), the same verdict for each model, and which number is short. Read-only: it sends nothing to anyone.

ceiling_in.description: Ceiling height in inches, to the lowest beam, duct or door track over that spot.

depth_in.description: Room depth in inches, front to back from the wall it folds against.

width_in.description: Room width in inches, wall to wall where the bay would stand.

name: check_fit
title: Check room fit
